title: Canvas loop with sky, ground, bird rectangle
task: Write game/index.html and game/main.mjs. index.html: one <canvas id="game" width="400" height="600"> and one <script type="module"> that imports { start } from "./main.mjs" and calls start(document.getElementById('game'), window, window.localStorage). main.mjs: export render(ctx, state) that fills the sky over the whole canvas, the ground band from GROUND_Y to CANVAS_H, and the bird rectangle at state.bird using fillRect only; export start(canvas, win, storage) that gets the '2d' context, keeps a placeholder state { bird: { x: BIRD_X, y: BIRD_START_Y, w: BIRD_W, h: BIRD_H, vy: 0 } }, and runs a loop with win.requestAnimationFrame that computes dt in seconds from the frame timestamp, caps it at MAX_DT, and calls render each frame. Import every number from ./constants.mjs; write no numeric literal except 0, 1, 2 and 1000 (milliseconds per second); colours and fonts are strings.

title: Gravity and flap as pure functions
task: Write game/physics.mjs exporting createBird(), flap(bird), step(bird, dt) exactly as the brief's Interfaces section states. Pure: return new objects, never mutate the argument. Import every number from ./constants.mjs.

title: Pipes: spawn, scroll, recycle, seeded random gap
task: Write game/pipes.mjs exporting createRng(seed), createPipes(), stepPipes(pipes, dt, rng) exactly as the brief's Interfaces section states. createRng must be a small deterministic integer-hash generator (no Math.random) returning numbers in [0, 1) and giving the same sequence for the same seed. Pure: return new objects and arrays, never mutate the arguments. Import every number from ./constants.mjs.

title: Collision as pure functions
task: Write game/collision.mjs exporting rectsOverlap(a, b), pipeRects(pipe), collides(bird, pipes), hitsGround(bird) exactly as the brief's Interfaces section states. Overlap is strict (touching edges do not overlap). Import every number from ./constants.mjs.

title: Score and best score in localStorage
task: Write game/score.mjs exporting updateScore(bird, pipes, score), loadBest(storage), saveBest(storage, best) exactly as the brief's Interfaces section states. updateScore returns a new pipes object whose list has passed set to true for every pair counted, and counts each pair once. loadBest returns 0 when the key is missing or the stored value is not a finite integer. Pure apart from storage calls. Import every number and BEST_KEY from ./constants.mjs.

title: Start and game-over screens, restart
task: Write game/machine.mjs exporting createState(seed, best), handleInput(state), tick(state, dt) exactly as the brief's Interfaces section states, composing physics.mjs, pipes.mjs, collision.mjs and score.mjs. Then rewrite game/main.mjs so render(ctx, state) draws the start screen, the play view with score and best text, and the game-over screen per R7 (fillText only for text), and start(canvas, win, storage) uses createState(Date.now(), loadBest(storage)), handleInput on keydown with code 'Space' and on pointerdown, tick each frame with capped dt, and saveBest(storage, state.best) when the mode becomes over. Keep the exports from the previous main.mjs. Import every number from ./constants.mjs.
